governance.status: ANALYTICAL LITERATURE REVIEW — HYPOTHESES NOT YET PROJECT-VALIDATED
governance.description: Audited Transfer Hypotheses v2: Forensic re-evaluation of all 10 candidate hypotheses with corrected literature support, explicit project inferences, removed misattributions, and accurate scope statements.

audit_table.name: ETD / Integrating Factor Integrator for Stiff Semilinear PDEs
audit_table.project_inference: Our IntegratingFactorModalODEIntegrator executes ETDRK4 accurately for polynomial reaction kinetics.
audit_table.misattribution: Previously claimed to 'prove unconditional stability'; corrected to a software/mathematical transfer smoke test.

audit_table.name: Stokes / Laplacian Geometry Eigenbasis for Heat Conduction & Thermal Transients
audit_table.project_inference: Our discrete MAC-staggered Stokes eigenmodes are exact discrete Laplacian eigenfunctions for scalar diffusion.

audit_table.name: Resolvent Input-Output Analysis for Boundary-Actuated Wall Shear Gain
audit_table.project_inference: Our existing discrete channel operators can compute the input-output gain structure for wall actuation without requiring full-state DNS.
audit_table.misattribution: Previously implied project had achieved drag reduction; corrected to testing whether our infrastructure reproduces known gain structures.

audit_table.name: On-the-Fly Pseudospectral Evaluator for Quadratic Conservation Laws (1D Burgers)
audit_table.project_inference: Our 3D real FFT evaluator generalizes component-wise to 1D/2D quadratic momentum advection and cross-field products.
audit_table.misattribution: Previously attributed to Schlegel & Noack 2015; corrected: our FFT evaluator is independent project evidence, supported generally by Orszag (1971).

audit_table.name: Solenoidal Modal Basis for Roberts-Flow Kinematic Induction/Dynamo
audit_table.project_inference: Our FourierSolenoidalBasis satisfies div B = 0 to machine precision, computing magnetic growth rates without magnetic monopole accumulation.
audit_table.misattribution: Previously named 'MHD Test'; renamed to 'Roberts-Flow Kinematic Induction/Dynamo Test' (velocity prescribed, B evolves, no Lorentz feedback, not full MHD).

audit_table.name: Clustered Local POD for Multi-Regime Bistable Structural Snap-Through
audit_table.project_inference: Our ClusteredLocalPODBasis partitions state-space snapshots into discrete operating basins with nearest-cluster projection.
audit_table.misattribution: None; properly cites Amsallem et al. (2012) and Kaiser et al. (2014).

audit_table.name: Divergence-Free Wave-Packet Dictionaries for Inverse Sensor Reconstruction
audit_table.project_inference: Our multiresolution solenoidal dictionary (W13-G) and NonorthogonalProjectionSolver can extract localized coherent vortex cores from sparse point sensors.
audit_table.misattribution: Decoupled from the failed W13-G full-state forward ROM claim; restricted to static coherent vortex extraction and sensor reconstruction.

audit_table.name: Separable Channel Eigenbasis for Acoustic Duct Resonators
audit_table.project_inference: Our tensor-product Fourier-sine basis spans exact rectangular acoustic duct cut-on and cut-off waveguide modes.

audit_table.name: Grassmannian Subspace Tracking for Neural Network Layer Stability
audit_table.project_inference: Our subspace_distance_metric computes exact principal angles between weight/activation subspaces across training checkpoints.
audit_table.misattribution: Previously claimed novel interpretability utility; held because standard ML packages (SVCCA, CKA) already exist in PyTorch.

audit_table.name: Domain-Agnostic Scientific Audit Infrastructure Package (`sciaudit`)
audit_table.project_inference: Our write-once SHA256 evidence directory, Python AST metric hashing, and automated recomputation pipeline operate on general files/arrays with zero CFD dependency.
audit_table.misattribution: Separated from scientific CFD scores into an independent Engineering/Infrastructure portfolio.

audit_table.name: Spatial Phase Alignment / Shifted POD Pretest (R_align Ratio)
audit_table.project_inference: Before implementing sPOD, measuring R_align = d_aligned / d_raw on existing cross-seed datasets will decisively determine whether translation/phase drift is the primary driver of POD failure.
audit_table.misattribution: Replaces the premature claim that sPOD 'will solve' cross-seed POD failure with a cheap falsification gate.
